blocks.content: Article 32 is the very soul of the Constitution and the very heart of it.

items: Article 148 deals with the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India, known as the guardian of the public purse.
Financial Emergency under Article 360 has never been declared in India so far.
Article 76 appoints the Attorney General for India, who has the right of audience in all courts in the territory of India.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 1 defines India, that is Bharat, as a 'Union of States' rather than a federation of states.
Article 32 guarantees the Right to Constitutional Remedies, empowering citizens to move the Supreme Court directly for enforcement of Fundamental Rights.
Article 51A prescribes the Fundamental Duties of citizens, added via the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976 on the recommendation of the Swaran Singh Committee.
Article 110 contains the definition and specific conditions governing a Money Bill.
Article 280 mandates the constitution of a Finance Commission by the President every five years to recommend tax distribution between the Centre and States.
